name: Italian Exhibition Group S.p.A.
summary: Italian Exhibition Group S.p.A. organizes trade shows and conferences in Italy and internationally. It engages in the organization of trade fair events; reception of trade fairs and other events, such as planning, management, and provision of exhibition spaces; publishing; and sporting events. The company also offers services related to trade fair and conference events, promotion, and management for congresses, conventions, exhibitions, cultural, entertainment, and leisure activities; catering, cleaning, and porterage services; and training courses. Italian Exhibition Group S.p.A. was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Rimini, Italy.
